context.title: نافذة الصباح
context.poem:
أتركُ كتابي قربَ النافذةِ.
يصلُ الضوءُ قبلَ أن يبردَ الشايُ.
أفتحُ البابَ قليلًا للنسيمِ.
ويبقى على الطاولةِ مكانٌ لصباحٍ آخرَ.

steps: Create a disposable shared document with the exact context poem and open it with the case's explicit --agent client.
In a real browser, right-click the target word and choose بالمعنى نفسه. Do not send a chat message, paste a response, or invoke respond.
Wait for actual model-generated suggestions. Read the canonical document before choosing one.
Select a plausible displayed replacement, then verify the exact saved text and revision through CLI get.
Use a conditional agent update to change لصباحٍ آخرَ to لضوءٍ جديدٍ. Verify both edits in the browser, then reload and inspect them again.
criteria: The header identifies the requested client and the real client returns at least one contextually plausible suggestion.
The word request and suggestions require no handoff modal, chat message or pasted JSON.
Generation alone leaves the poem at revision 1 with exact original text; selection changes only the intended word at revision 2.
The subsequent conditional agent edit creates revision 3, preserves the chosen word and appears in the browser without a manual refresh.

Both accepted changes survive a page reload. Record runtime, exact request/response hashes, package hashes and client versions; do not infer literary accuracy or another host's behavior from this small trial.
